the proposed approach of using unsupervised clustering and tuning BERT for a downstream text classification task improves model performance in low resource settings.

1) we propose an unsupervised text classification task that can be performed on a target dataset before fine-tuning on a downstream classification task, 2) we show empirically that the proposed unsupervised text clustering and tuning (Cluster & Tune) method improves performance on the target task, and 3) we provide evidence that Cluster & Tune is effective in low-resource settings, and is robust to hyperparameters, and to the choice of unsupervised clustering method.
